Small Business Bookkeeping in Austin

Northwind Bookkeeping keeps the books for more than one hundred small businesses in Austin and the surrounding area: contractors, clinics, restaurants, agencies and online shops. Every month we reconcile your bank and card accounts, categorize every transaction, send you a simple profit and loss report, and keep your books ready for your tax preparer. You get one named bookkeeper who answers email within one business day.

What is included every month?

Bank and credit card reconciliation, categorization of income and expenses, accounts payable and receivable tracking, a monthly profit and loss statement, a balance sheet, and a short call to walk through the numbers. Payroll processing and sales tax filing are available as add-ons for a fixed monthly fee.

How much does monthly bookkeeping cost?

Pricing is a flat monthly fee based on how many transactions you have. Most of our clients pay between 300 and 900 USD per month. There are no hourly surprises: if your volume changes for three months in a row, we talk about it before anything changes on your invoice.

Do you work with QuickBooks and Xero?

Yes. Our team is certified in QuickBooks Online and Xero. If you are moving from spreadsheets or from another system, we handle the migration and check every opening balance with you before the first month closes.

Can you clean up books that are months behind?

Yes. Many clients come to us after falling behind during a busy season. We start with a free review of your accounts, quote the catch-up work once, and then move you onto the regular monthly plan.

Who we work with

Owner-run businesses with one to fifty employees, from home service companies to medical practices. If you are not sure we are a fit, book a fifteen minute call and we will tell you honestly.
